exercises.name: libft_creator
exercises.description: Create a shell script `libft_creator.sh` that compiles the provided .c files and creates `libft.a` (a static library). The script must run with `sh libft_creator.sh` and produce `libft.a` in the same directory.

exercises.name: Makefile
exercises.description: Create a `Makefile` that compiles `libft.a` from source files in `srcs/` (ft_putchar.c, ft_swap.c, ft_putstr.c, ft_strlen.c, ft_strcmp.c) and header in `includes/ft.h`. It must implement rules: `all`, `clean`, `fclean`, `re`, `libft.a`. Use `-Wall -Wextra -Werror`. No unnecessary recompilation.

exercises.name: ft_split
exercises.description: Split `str` using any character from `charset` as separator. Return a NULL‑terminated array of strings (no empty strings). The input string is read‑only. Memory must be allocated with `malloc`.
